title: MobLand Season 2 Release Date Gets Good & Bad News From Guy Ritchie
text:
Guy Ritchie gave an update on release date of Tom Hardy's MobLand Season 2. It is a good and bad news for fans.
, and the news is decidedly mixed. The producer and director confirmed when the Tom Hardy crime drama will be back.will release before the end of 2026, ruling out a lengthy wait until 2027.
But for fans hoping to see new episodes this summer, the timeline points to a longer hold than early production wraps had suggested.that has MobLand in the latter part of the year.
“We’ve got MobLand before the end of the year,” he said. The update is the first time someone directly involved has narrowed the release date window since a Paramount+ promo voiced by Helen Mirren teased the return.from December 2025 showed Pierce Brosnan and Mirren in costume on location. By February, leaked photos showed Hardy shooting along the River Thames with Joanne Froggatt.
Cast members began confirming the wrap in March, with Emmett J. Scanlan, who plays enforcer Paul O’Donnell, telling followers on Instagram the experience was “genuinely extraordinary” and describing Season 2 as “Season 1 on steroids. ” The speed of MobLand’s production had raised hopes of a quicker turnaround for Season 2. Season 1 premiered just days after filming finished, so a summer launch seemed plausible once the wrap was announced.
Ritchie’s comments now suggest post-production will take considerably longer this time around.has already teased where the story might head in MobLand Season 2.
